screens.title: Offense: Play type
screens.when: Every scrimmage down. On a two-point try, only Run and Pass.

choices.label: Run
choices.description: Keep the ball on the ground.

choices.label: Pass
choices.description: Throw the ball.

choices.label: Kick
choices.description: Punt it away or try a field goal. Only on 4th down, or on any down in the last two minutes of a half.

choices.label: Clock
choices.description: Stop the clock or run it down.

screens.title: Offense: Formation
screens.when: Before a Run or Pass play.

choices.label: Shotgun
choices.description: The quarterback stands a few yards behind the center.

choices.label: Under center
choices.description: The quarterback takes the snap directly from the center.

choices.label: Pistol
choices.description: A short shotgun with the running back lined up directly behind the quarterback.

choices.label: Empty
choices.description: No running back. Everyone except the quarterback spreads out to catch passes.

choices.label: Heavy
choices.description: Extra linemen or tight ends packed in tight, built to push for short yards.

choices.label: Inside run
choices.description: A handoff straight up the middle, between the guards.

choices.label: Outside run
choices.description: A handoff toward the edge, outside the tackles.

choices.label: QB sneak
choices.description: The quarterback takes the snap and pushes forward behind the center for a yard or two.

choices.label: Short
choices.description: A quick throw less than 10 yards past the line.

choices.label: Intermediate
choices.description: A throw 10 to 19 yards past the line.

choices.label: Deep
choices.description: A long throw, 20 yards or more past the line.

choices.label: Screen
choices.description: A short throw behind the line, with blockers out in front of the catcher.

choices.label: Play action
choices.description: Fake a handoff first, then throw.

choices.label: Punt
choices.description: Kick the ball away to pin the other team deep.

choices.label: Field goal
choices.description: Kick at the goal posts for three points.

choices.label: Spike
choices.description: Throw the ball into the ground to stop the clock. Uses up a down.

choices.label: Kneel
choices.description: The quarterback kneels down to keep the clock running.

choices.label: Kick extra point
choices.description: Kick for one point.

choices.label: Go for two
choices.description: Run one play from close in for two points.

screens.title: Kickoff
screens.when: Your kickoff. Only you choose here for now; the computer has no kickoff caller yet.

choices.label: Kickoff
choices.description: A normal kick deep to the other team.

choices.label: Onside kick
choices.description: A short kick your team tries to recover.

screens.title: Defense: Package
screens.when: Every scrimmage down and every two-point try.

choices.label: Base
choices.description: Four defensive backs, built to stop the run.

choices.label: Nickel
choices.description: Five defensive backs, the everyday mix of run and pass defense.

choices.label: Dime
choices.description: Six defensive backs, for obvious passing downs.

choices.label: Specials
choices.description: Goal line and prevent.

choices.label: Base Cover 3
choices.description: Four defensive backs, three deep defenders split the field in thirds, four rushers.

choices.label: Base Cover 2
choices.description: Four defensive backs, two deep safeties split the field in halves, four rushers.

choices.label: Run Stuff
choices.description: Eight or more defenders near the line, one deep safety, man coverage behind them.

choices.label: Nickel Cover 3
choices.description: Five defensive backs, three deep defenders in zones, four rushers.

choices.label: Nickel Cover 4
choices.description: Five defensive backs, four deep defenders each guard a quarter of the field, four rushers.

choices.label: Nickel Cover 2
choices.description: Five defensive backs, two deep safeties split the field in halves, zones underneath, four rushers.

choices.label: Nickel 2-Man
choices.description: Five defensive backs, two deep safeties split the field, everyone else plays man.

choices.label: Nickel Cover 1
choices.description: Five defensive backs, one deep safety, man coverage underneath, four rushers.

choices.label: Nickel Cover 1 Blitz
choices.description: Five defensive backs, one deep safety, man coverage, five or more rushers.

choices.label: Dime Cover 4
choices.description: Six defensive backs, four deep zones, four rushers. Gives up short gains to stop long ones.

choices.label: Dime Cover 0 Blitz
choices.description: Six defensive backs, no deep safety, pure man coverage, six or more rushers.

choices.label: Goal Line
choices.description: Three or fewer defensive backs, everyone crowded at the line to stop a short run.

choices.label: Prevent
choices.description: Six or more defensive backs playing deep zones with four or fewer rushers. Stops the long pass, allows short ones.
